profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at First Advantage
profile.summary: Specialties: .net,  cobol,  conversion,  customer relations,  delivery,  delphi,  html,  javascript,  microsoft windows,  programming,  troubleshooting,  visual c#

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Have fulfilled the role of Technical Lead since May 2010; have occasionally fulfilled the role of scrum master in addition to other duties.  Responsibilities include correcting software defects, analyzing requirements and providing time estimates for new projects, and designing/coding software changes and enhancements.  Also serve as primary source control integrator for the TaxWise Desktop software. Responsible for timely delivery of assignments, and for providing support to other teams whose products interface with the TaxWise product.

positions.title: Technical Support Representative
positions.description:
Responsible for providing timely and accurate technical support for common issues with the company's main software product in a courteous, efficient manner.  Issues included, but were not limited to, basic troubleshooting of communications and printing issues, and determining whether an issue was related to data or software.
Served as a member of a team which used PHP/MySQL and Visual C#/Visual Basic/ASP.NET to develop internal applications used by the Technical Support Department to facilitate the technical support call process and by the Training Department to facilitate the process of evaluating employees for advancement within the company.  Also worked with the team to develop web-based surveys used by employees to evaluate internal customer service processes, and preliminary work for a web-based survey used by customers to evaluate the level of Customer Service received.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for correcting errors, modifying software to customer specifications, and performing updates to associated documentation.
Y2K software conversion for various customers.
Assisted with design of an e-commerce application using ColdFusion 4.5.
Assisted with modernization of existing HP COBOL software package and with porting this application from the HP e3000 platform in an MPE/ix environment to an open platform (specifically, a Windows-based environment).

		Berry College Continuing Education Department
